properties.description: TORNADO WATCH 512 REMAINS VALID UNTIL 1 AM CDT EARLY THIS MORNING FOR THE FOLLOWING AREAS: in southeast Nebraska this watch includes Gage, Jefferson, Lancaster and Saline counties. Supercells capable of producing tornadoes, large hail and damaging winds are possible this evening.
properties.instruction: A Tornado Watch means conditions are favorable for tornadoes in and close to the watch area. Be prepared to move to a place of safety if a warning is issued.
